case.summary: The alert was triggered by a noisy legacy risk score of 0.55 on an in-person transaction of $30.91. However, the second-generation model score is very low at 0.008, which correlates with a 0.6% historical fraud rate. Shared origin analysis for the billing region shows a low fraud lift of 0.3, indicating no coordinated fraud ring. Similar past alerts have consistently been cleared as legitimate, leading to the conclusion that this is a false positive.
